name: Blue Star Ltd.
business_summary: Air-conditioning and commercial-refrigeration specialist: (1) electro-mechanical projects and commercial AC systems (MEP, data-centre cooling, ~66% of Q2 FY27 revenue), (2) unitary products (room ACs, VRF, chillers, coolers, water purifiers; seasonal, peak in Q4/Q1), (3) professional electronics and industrial solutions. Largest after-sales service network for AC. Low margin (7% EBITDA), working-capital intensive, copper/aluminium and USD-import heavy. MedTech business sold in Q2 FY27 (Rs23cr exceptional gain).

revenue_mix.geography: India (+Qatar/UAE small); Q2 FY27 share, full-year ~40%
India; Q2 share, full-year ~50% due to Q4/Q1 seasonality

exposures.mechanism: Copper+aluminium ~15% of total costs (copper ~10%, model estimate; compressors, coils, tubing). +10% copper => +1.0% costs => EBITDA -14% at 7% margin; ~70% recovered through three 2026 price hikes (latest +8% from 1 Oct) => -4%; EV/MCap 1.05, persistence 0.4 => -1.7. Pack empirical is +1.89 (t=1.9), opposite sign: it reflects copper as a global-growth proxy; model keeps the cost sign but widens the range to include +0.5.

evidence.note: AC/TV/appliance price hikes of up to 8% from 1 Oct on copper, aluminium, freight; Blue Star +8%, LG +5-7%, Daikin +8-10% from 16 Sep
